story.title: WHO SAYS THE SKY IS BLUE?
paragraphs_en: Who says the sky is blue? I drew a picture today, And I painted it purple. My sky was a beautiful, bright purple... What’s blue for you, Is purple for me, It’s not how you look at it, But what you really see! Yes, the sky does seem blue, But imagine what it COULD be. What if the sky were purple? Would the crows turn pink for me? Who says the sky is blue? I drew a picture today, And I painted it purple. My sky was a beautiful, bright purple... What’s blue for you, Is purple for me, It’s not how you look at it, But what you really see! Yes, the sky does seem blue, But imagine what it COULD be. What if the sky were purple? Would the crows turn pink for me?

Who says the grass is green? I drew a picture today, And I painted it orange. My grass was a beautiful, shining orange... What’s green for you, Is orange for me, It’s not how you look at it, But what you really see! Yes, the grass does seem green, But imagine what it COULD be. What if the grass were orange? Would the bees turn turquoise for me?

Who says the sun is yellow? I drew a picture today, And I painted it maroon. My sun was a beautiful, deep maroon... What’s yellow for you, Is maroon for me, It’s not how you look at it, But what you really see! Yes, the sun does seem yellow, But imagine what it COULD be. What if the sun were maroon? Would the clouds turn gold for me?

Who says a strawberry is red? I drew a picture today, And I painted it silver. My strawberry was a beautiful, shimmering silver... What’s red for you, Is silver for me, It’s not how you look at it, But what you really see! Yes, a strawberry does seem red, But imagine what it COULD be. What if the strawberry were silver? Would the cream turn black for me?
So the next time you draw a picture, Pause... before you paint it in, Imagine what it COULD be. Dream... And... only then begin.
